label: Site name
help: Shown in the browser tab, the header, search results and every email your site sends.

label: Contact email
help: Where messages from the contact form and important admin notices are sent.

label: Short description
help: One or two sentences about your site. Google and social networks show it under your site name.

label: Keywords (old)
help: Google ignores this today. Kept only for old search engines.

label: Videos per page
help: On the homepage list, categories and Trending.

label: Comments per page
help: Comments shown before "Show more".

label: Channels per page
help: On the channels list.

label: Search results per page
help: Results shown per page of search.

label: Activity items per page
help: On a channel's activity tab.

label: Videos on a channel's home tab
help: How many to show (videos on a channel's home tab). Fewer items load faster on phones.

label: Playlists on a channel's home tab
help: How many to show (playlists on a channel's home tab). Fewer items load faster on phones.

label: Rows in creator dashboard boxes
help: How many items each box on a creator's own dashboard lists. (Not the admin Home.)

label: Channels in "Discover channels"
help: Most channels the Discover channels page draws from.

label: Search suggestions
help: How many suggestions appear while someone types in the search box.

label: Videos in "Up next"
help: How many related videos are listed beside the player.

label: Keep search history for
help: Days. Older searches are deleted automatically.

label: Most searches kept
help: Oldest searches are deleted above this number, to keep the database small.

label: Clean search history every
help: Minutes between automatic clean-ups.

label: Let visitors create accounts
help: Turn off to stop new sign-ups. People who already have an account can still log in.

label: Sign in with Google or Facebook
help: Shows Google and Facebook buttons on the login page (needs keys set up by your developer).

label: Let members upload videos
help: When off, nobody can upload, administrators too: the upload window says uploads are disabled. The Upload button stays until you hide it in Appearance > Header, menus & footer. Imports are not affected.

label: Let other sites embed your videos
help: Other websites can show your videos in their pages with the embed code.

label: Trending page
help: Shows the Trending page and its link in the menu.

label: Watch history
help: Remembers what signed-in members watched so they can find it again.

label: Longest video members can upload
help: In seconds. 3600 = 1 hour.

label: Allowed video file types
help: File endings members may upload, separated by commas, for example mp4, webm, mov.

label: New uploads start as
help: Who can see a member's video right after upload, before they change it.

label: Default video language
help: Pre-selected language in the upload form.

label: Let members upload their own thumbnail
help: Members can pick their own picture for a video instead of a frame from the video.

label: Thumbnail width
help: Width of thumbnails your site makes from videos, in pixels.

label: Thumbnail height
help: Height of thumbnails your site makes from videos, in pixels.

label: Upload18 key
help: Connects member uploads to your Upload18 account. Keep it private.

label: Upload18 address
help: The Upload18 server address. Only change it if Upload18 tells you to.

label: Upload18 category number
help: Category used on Upload18 for new uploads.

label: Upload18 server number
help: Upload18 storage server for new uploads.

label: Upload18 folder number
help: Your Upload18 folder for new uploads.

label: Upload piece size
help: Big files are sent in pieces of this size (MB). Lower it if uploads fail on slow connections.

label: Thumbnails made per upload
help: How many frames Upload18 captures from each video to choose a thumbnail from.

label: Largest thumbnail file
help: Biggest thumbnail picture members can upload, in KB.

label: Notifications sent per batch
help: When you notify everyone, messages go out in batches of this size. Lower it on small hosting.

label: How emails are sent
help: Choose your email service. "Log only" means emails are NOT delivered (testing only).

label: Server address
help: From your email provider, for example smtp.gmail.com or mail.yourdomain.com.

label: Port
help: Usually 587 (with TLS) or 465 (with SSL). Your provider tells you which.

label: Username
help: Usually your full email address.

label: Password
help: Your email password or app password. Stored safely and never shown again.

label: Security
help: TLS for port 587, SSL for port 465. Only choose None if your provider says so.

label: Send emails from
help: The address members see. Use an address on your own domain so emails do not land in spam.

label: Sender name
help: The name members see next to your emails, usually your site name.

label: Support email
help: Shown to members as the address for help with their account.

label: Alerts email
help: Where the site sends technical alerts such as failed imports or a full disk.

label: Comments
help: Visitors can comment under videos. Turn off to hide all comments and the comment box.

label: Allow replies to comments
help: Members can answer a comment directly under it.

label: Replies shown at first
help: How many replies show before a "Show more" link.

label: Long comments are cut after
help: Number of characters before a long comment shows "Read more".

label: Count a repeat view after
help: Minutes before the same visitor watching again adds another view.

label: View records to keep
help: "Counter only" keeps totals and saves the most space.

label: Daily view totals
help: Keeps one small row per video per day for charts and Trending. Leave on.

label: Keep detailed view records for
help: Days. Totals are kept forever; only the detailed rows are deleted.

label: Sign-ups allowed per visitor
help: How many accounts one internet address can create in a short time. Stops sign-up spam.

label: Largest profile picture
help: Biggest profile picture file members can upload, in KB (1024 KB = 1 MB).

label: Largest channel banner
help: Biggest channel banner file members can upload, in KB (1024 KB = 1 MB).

label: Ask new members to confirm their email
help: New members must click a link in an email before they can upload or comment. Needs working email.

label: Let members delete their account
help: Shows a Delete account button in member settings.

label: Show subscriber counts
help: Shows how many subscribers each channel has on channel pages and cards.

label: Creator tips box
help: Shows creators which of their videos need a better title, thumbnail or description.

label: Tips shown
help: How many videos the creator tips box lists.

label: Tips look at the last
help: Days of uploads the creator tips box checks.

label: Creator alerts box
help: Warns creators about problems such as failed uploads or removed videos.

label: Alerts shown
help: How many alerts the creator alerts box lists.

label: Alerts look at the last
help: Days of activity the creator alerts box checks.

label: Comeback checklist for creators
help: Suggests next steps to creators who stopped uploading.

label: Checklist steps shown
help: How many steps the comeback checklist shows.

label: Show it after no uploads for
help: Days without uploads before the comeback checklist appears.

help: Lets creators change the banner of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

help: Lets creators change the avatar of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the animation
help: Lets creators change the motion of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the visual effects
help: Lets creators change the effects of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the background pattern
help: Lets creators change the pattern of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the header shape
help: Lets creators change the shape of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the video list layout
help: Lets creators change the video layout of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the featured video
help: Lets creators change the featured video of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the featured section layout
help: Lets creators change the featured layout of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the featured rows and columns
help: Lets creators change the featured sizing of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the latest uploads section
help: Lets creators change the latest uploads of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the latest uploads layout
help: Lets creators change the latest layout of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the latest uploads rows and columns
help: Lets creators change the latest sizing of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the playlists section
help: Lets creators change the playlists of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the playlists layout
help: Lets creators change the playlists layout of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the playlists rows and columns
help: Lets creators change the playlists sizing of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the About sections
help: Lets creators change the sections of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the call-to-action button
help: Lets creators change the cta of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the statistics box
help: Lets creators change the stats of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the website links
help: Lets creators change the socials of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Creators can change the upload schedule
help: Lets creators change the upload rhythm of their own channel page. Off keeps your site design on every channel.

label: Show ads
help: Turns all ad spaces on or off at once.

label: No ads for premium members
help: Paying members never see ads.

label: Video ad before the video
help: Plays a short ad before videos start.

label: Pop-under ad on click
help: Opens your ad network's page behind the site when a visitor first clicks.

label: Ad break length
help: How long the video ad plays before the video, from 1 to 60 seconds. A shorter ad video ends sooner. Viewers can skip it after 3 seconds.

label: Video ad files

label: Default ad click link
help: Opened when a video ad without its own link is clicked. Empty = ads are not clickable.

label: Ad after every
help: Number of videos before an ad appears in video lists.

label: Most ads per list

label: Ad shape in video lists

label: Box next to the video
help: Shown beside the player on video pages.

label: Backup for video ads
help: HTML ad shown when no video ad file is set or it fails to load.

label: Banner at the bottom
help: Shown above the footer on every page.

label: Small banner on phones
help: A small banner phone visitors can close. Use compact ad sizes.

label: Pop-under ad code
help: Paste the pop-under script from your ad network.

label: Visitors see
help: Dark or light for first-time visitors. Visitors can switch if the theme switcher is on.

label: Main colour
help: Buttons, links and highlights.

label: Second colour
help: Used with the main colour in gradients and badges.

label: Highlight colour
help: Small details such as live dots and some badges.

label: Page background (dark)
help: Background colour of pages in dark mode.

label: Card background (dark)
help: Background of cards, menus and panels in dark mode.

label: Page background (light)
help: Background colour of pages in light mode.

label: Card background (light)
help: Background of cards, menus and panels in light mode.

label: Videos per row on computers
help: On category, trending and search pages. The homepage list has its own setting.

label: Card look
help: Glass (see-through), solid, or high contrast.

label: Corner roundness
help: Sharper or rounder corners on cards, buttons and thumbnails.

label: Amount of movement
help: Full, reduced or no animation. Visitors who ask their device for less motion always get less.

label: Spacing
help: Compact, comfortable or relaxed space between items.

label: Videos per row on phones
help: One big video or two smaller ones per row.

label: Card size on phones
help: Compact fits more on screen.

label: Video preview in the creator studio
help: Play in the list, or open with a Preview button (lighter).

label: Text size
help: Size of normal text in pixels. 16 is easy to read.

label: Menu and button text size
help: Percent of normal size. 100 = normal.

label: Heading size
help: Percent of normal size. 100 = normal.

label: Video title size on cards
help: Percent of normal size. 100 = normal.

label: Text contrast
help: "Strong" makes text darker or brighter so it is easier to read.

label: Scrollbar look
help: Subtle, glass or in your theme colour (computers only).

label: Upload window style
help: How upload window style looks. Use Preview to see it on your site before publishing.

label: Logo
help: Shown in the header and in Google. Upload a PNG, SVG or WebP, about 160x40 pixels.

label: Browser tab icon
help: The small icon in the browser tab and bookmarks. Square PNG or SVG, at least 64x64.

label: Copyright line
help: The small line at the very bottom, for example (c) 2026 Your Site.

label: Announcement text
help: Keep it short. Links are allowed.

label: Footer title
help: Leave empty to use your site name.

label: Footer tagline
help: One sentence about your site under the footer title.

label: "Explore" heading
help: The words shown for "Explore" heading. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: "Explore" links
help: One link per line: Name | address.

label: "Categories" heading
help: The words shown for "Categories" heading. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Category links
help: Leave empty to list your first categories automatically.

label: Categories listed
help: How many to show (categories listed). Fewer items load faster on phones.

label: "Support" heading
help: The words shown for "Support" heading. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: "Support" links
help: One link per line: Name | address.

label: "Settings" heading
help: The words shown for "Settings" heading. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Bottom line links
help: One link per line, for example Terms | /terms.

label: Name next to the logo
help: Leave empty to show your site name.

label: Premium button text
help: The words shown for premium button text. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Upload button text
help: The words shown for upload button text. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Sign in button text
help: The words shown for sign in button text. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Register button text
help: The words shown for register button text. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Side menu links
help: One link per line: Name | address | icon. Shown to everyone.

label: Links for signed-in members
help: One link per line, shown under the main links.

label: Playlists heading
help: The words shown for playlists heading. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Playlists shown
help: How many to show (playlists shown). Fewer items load faster on phones.

label: Subscriptions heading
help: The words shown for subscriptions heading. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Subscriptions shown
help: How many to show (subscriptions shown). Fewer items load faster on phones.

label: "Discover channels" text
help: The words shown for "Discover channels" text. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Categories heading
help: The words shown for categories heading. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Categories shown
help: How many to show (categories shown). Fewer items load faster on phones.

label: Premium link text
help: {site_name} is replaced by your site name.

label: "Show more" text
help: The words shown for "Show more" text. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: "Show less" text
help: The words shown for "Show less" text. Leave empty to use the default text (translated automatically).

label: Heading text
help: For example "Related videos" or "Up next".

label: Related videos come from
help: Same creator, same category, newest, or a mix.

label: Custom CSS
help: Your own style rules, added after the theme.

label: Custom JavaScript
help: Runs on every public page. A mistake can break the site.

label: Code in the page head
help: For analytics and site-verification tags.

label: Small line above the title
help: A few words, for example "Fresh picks".

label: Welcome title
help: The big line of the welcome text.

label: Welcome sentence
help: One sentence under the welcome title.

label: Main list shows
help: Newest, most viewed, trending, most commented, or one category.

label: Category for the main list
help: Used when the main list shows one category.

label: Videos per row in the main list
help: On computers. Phones use the phone setting.

label: More videos load
help: Automatically while scrolling, with a "Load more" button, or with page numbers.

label: Section animation
help: Slide, lift, zoom or fade.

label: Animation length
help: Milliseconds. 700 is calm; lower is snappier.

label: Slide distance
help: How far sections move while appearing, in pixels.

label: Delay between cards
help: Milliseconds between each card in a cascade.

label: Self-scroll speed
help: How fast rows move on their own.

label: "Fresh picks" moves
help: Direction of the Fresh picks row animation.

label: "Tags" row moves
help: Direction of the tags row animation.

label: "Creators" row moves
help: Direction of the creators row animation.

label: "Actors" row moves
help: Direction of the trending actors row animation.

label: Player frame
help: Cinematic, soft or minimal frame around the player.

label: "Up next" list spacing
help: Compact fits more videos; relaxed is easier to scan.

label: Info page spacing
help: How info page spacing looks. Use Preview to see it on your site before publishing.

label: Info page width
help: Standard, wide or full width.

label: Theme
help: The colours, fonts, card style and page layouts your site uses. Pick it in the gallery above.

label: Video length label
help: The look of the length label on thumbnails.

label: "New" label for
help: Days a new video shows the "New" label. 0 = never.

label: Title lines
help: How many lines of a long title show before it is cut.

label: Glow around the player
help: Off, soft, vivid or cinema.

label: Next video starts after
help: Seconds of countdown before the next video plays. 0 = off.

label: Header style
help: Solid, slim, translucent, a floating island, two rows, or over the banner on pages that have one.

label: Ring around creator pictures
help: A coloured ring, a plain ring, or none.

label: Category tile look
help: How category tiles look on the homepage and Explore.

label: "Back to top" look
help: How "Back to top" look looks. Use Preview to see it on your site before publishing.

label: Homepage layout
help: The overall arrangement of your homepage.

label: Top banner
help: What sits at the very top of the homepage: slides, a big video with tiles, ranked lists, a lead story or nothing.

label: Change slide every
help: Seconds (3-15).

label: Video page layout
help: Where the player, title and "Up next" list sit.

label: Card style
help: How each video looks in lists.

label: Pop-up window style
help: How pop-up windows open: centred, sliding sheet, full screen or sharp.

label: Animation style
help: How lively animations feel, from calm to energetic.

label: On slower devices
help: Auto gives each device the effects it can handle. Recommended.

label: Page background effect
help: A still or moving background behind your pages.

label: Fonts
help: A heading font and a text font that work together. Each theme picks one; you can change it.

label: Player colour filter
help: Changes the video's colours, for example warmer or more contrast. None keeps real colours.

label: Speed of that light
help: Slow, normal or fast.

label: What changes every day
help: Colours only keeps your design and rotates its colour styles. Theme too also rotates the theme by season.

label: Try a specific day
help: 0 = today. Pick 1-366 to show that day's design on the live site.

label: Visual effects
help: Main switch for every decorative effect below.

label: Looping animations
help: Small animations that keep moving, such as pulsing badges.

label: Smooth changes
help: Colours and sizes change smoothly instead of jumping.

label: Movement when pointing
help: Buttons and cards move slightly under the mouse.

label: Colour gradients
help: Gradient fills on buttons, badges and headings.

label: Frosted glass
help: See-through blurred panels. The most expensive effect on phones.

label: Shadows and glows
help: Soft shadows and coloured glows around cards and buttons.

label: Header stays visible
help: The top bar stays on screen while scrolling.

label: Loading shimmer
help: A light sweep over placeholders while videos load.

label: Use my text sizes
help: Turn off to ignore the four size settings and use the theme sizes.

label: Searchable drop-down lists
help: Long lists on forms get a search box.

label: Hide scrollbars on sideways rows
help: Cleaner rows of chips and videos; scrolling still works.

label: Stop hover effects adding scrollbars
help: Prevents a flicker of scrollbars when cards grow on hover.

label: Colourful headings
help: Section headings use a gradient of your theme colours.

label: Shine across headings
help: A slow light sweep across colourful headings. Off on slow phones automatically.

label: Scripted animations
help: Homepage section animations and page reveals. Needed for "Animate homepage sections".

label: Remember dark/light choice
help: Each visitor's dark or light choice is remembered on their device.

label: Remember theater mode
help: The player opens the way each viewer last left it.

label: Smooth scrolling
help: Links on the same page glide instead of jumping.

label: "Copied" message
help: A small message confirms when a link is copied.

label: Load comments when reached
help: Comments load only when the viewer scrolls to them. Makes video pages faster.

label: Search box
help: The search box in the top bar.

label: Upload button
help: Shown to every signed-in member, also while uploads are switched off.

label: Notifications bell
help: For signed-in members.

label: Premium button
help: A small button that opens the Premium page.

label: Sign in button
help: For visitors who are not signed in.

label: Register button
help: For visitors who are not signed in.

label: Use my side menu links
help: Turn off to show the default links instead of yours.

label: "Discover channels" link
help: Shows "Discover channels" link when on. Turn it off to hide it for every visitor.

label: Heading above "Up next"
help: Shows a title above the related videos list.

label: Channel name on related videos
help: Shows who made each related video.

label: Views and date on related videos
help: Shows views and upload date under each related video.

label: Side menu open on computers
help: The menu on the left stays open on big screens.

label: Playlists in the side menu
help: Shows the member's playlists.

label: Remind members before the trial ends
help: Days before the trial ends that members get a reminder email.

label: Requests per minute (whole site)
help: How often one visitor may load data per minute before being slowed down.

label: Login tries per minute
help: Failed logins allowed per minute from one address before a pause.

label: Uploads per minute
help: How many requests one member's uploads may send to your site per minute: the start, the checks while the video is processed, the finish, and each piece of the file when your server stores it. More are refused until the minute is over.

label: Subscribes per minute
help: How often one member may subscribe or unsubscribe per minute.

label: Comments per minute
help: How many comments one member may post per minute.

label: Reports per minute
help: How many reports one visitor may send per minute.

label: Searches per minute
help: How many searches one visitor may run per minute.

label: Views counted per minute
help: How many video views from one visitor count per minute. Stops view inflation.

label: Sites allowed to use your API
help: Other websites allowed to load data from your site. * = any site.

label: Allowed request types
help: Leave * unless your developer says otherwise.

label: Sites allowed to embed your videos
help: One website per line. Leave empty to allow every site (when embedding is on).

label: Browser cache for API checks
help: Seconds a browser may remember the API permission check.

label: Allow signed-in API requests from other sites
help: Lets other sites act as a logged-in member. Only with trusted sites.

label: Facebook page
help: Full link to your Facebook page. Shown as an icon in the footer when filled in.

label: X (Twitter) profile
help: Full link to your X profile. Shown as an icon in the footer when filled in.

label: Instagram profile
help: Full link to your Instagram profile. Shown in the footer when filled in.

label: YouTube channel
help: Full link to your YouTube channel. Shown in the footer when filled in.

label: TikTok profile
help: Full link to your TikTok profile. Shown in the footer when filled in.

label: Discord server
help: Invite link to your Discord server. Shown in the footer when filled in.

label: Telegram channel
help: Link to your Telegram channel or group. Shown in the footer when filled in.

label: Maintenance mode
help: Visitors see a "back soon" page instead of your site. You can still use the site and the admin.

label: Admins can still browse the site
help: Signed-in admins see the normal site during maintenance. Keep on so you can check your changes.

label: Secret preview link
help: Anyone with this link can see the site during maintenance. Share it only with people you trust.
card: Who can still see the site

label: Message for visitors
help: Shown on the maintenance page.

label: Tell Google to come back after
help: Seconds. 3600 = 1 hour. Stops Google treating your site as broken.
card: Who can still see the site

label: Internet addresses that see the site
help: One address per line. These visitors see the normal site during maintenance.
card: Who can still see the site

label: Colour style
help: The colours of the chosen theme. Every style keeps text readable in dark and light mode.

label: Side menu style
help: Full menu, a slim icon rail, a floating panel, or no side menu (the main links move into the header).

label: Also change layouts
help: With "Theme too", the homepage layout changes with the daily theme. Off keeps your own layout every day.

label: Keep text on my colours readable
help: If your colour is too light or too dark for white or black text, buttons use a slightly adjusted shade. Turning this off is not accessible.
